senses.gloss: ऋते॑न (ए॑न), ind. right, duly, properly, regularly, lawfully, according to usage or right, RV.; AV.
truly, sincerely, indeed, RV.; MBh. i.
ऋते-कर्म॑म् ind. while (Indra) pours down rain, during the rain [Sāy.], RV. x, 55, 7
ऋते—कर्म॑म् ind. without work [BRD.], RV. x, 55, 7 (cf. under ऋत॑, p. 224, col. 1.)
ऋते-जा॑ mfn. produced or come forth at the time of sacrifice [Sāy.], RV. i, 113, 12; vi, 3, 1; vii, 20, 6.
ऋते—भङ्ग mf(आ)n. (prob.) without separation (i.e. analysis), Gobh.
ऋते—स्फ्य mfn. without the Sphya, ĀpŚr.

ऋते॑ ind. (according to BRD. loc. case of the p.p. of √ ऋ) under pain of, with the exclusion of, excepting, besides, without, unless (with abl. or acc. or a sentence beginning with यतस्), RV.; AV. &c., MBh.; Pañcat. &c.
ऋते—बर्हिष्क mfn. without the formula on the Barhis (q.v.), ŚāṅkhŚr.
ऋते—मूल mfn. without roots, MaitrS. i.
ऋते—यज्ञ॑म् ind. outside the sacrifice, MaitrS. i.
ऋते—रक्षस् mfn. performed with exclusion of the Rakshases (as a sacrifice), AitBr. ii, 7, 2.
ऋतेयु m. N. of a Ṛṣi
of a son of Raudrāśva, (v.l. ऋचेयु, q.v.)
